title: NIPSA Versus Marginal Approach by Palatal Incision and MIST in Periodontal Regeneration
official: Non-Incised Papillae Surgical Approach (NIPSA) Versus Marginal Approach by Palatal Incision and Minimally Invasive Surgical Technique (MIST) in Periodontal Regeneration: a Ramdomized Clinical Trial
summary: Three techniques for periodontal reconstruction will be compared, in which marginal access versus apical access will be carried out.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients diagnosed with periodontitis.
* plaque index and bleeding index of \< 30%.
* periodontal lesions with pocket probing depth \> 5 mm.
* intrabony defect \> 3 mm.
* intrabony defect configuration including a 1 and/or 2-wall component, always involving the buccal wall.

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients with systemic diseases that contraindicated treatment.
* third molars.
* teeth with incorrect endodontic or restorative treatment.
